g.title: legend
g.text: Boxes: ROS nodes / devices. Notes: topics or launch constraints.
The ONNX bench and the hybrid hardware path are separate launches; they are not composed automatically.
Only one CAN backend may own can1 at a time. The shipped motor registry is hardware_verified: false.
Advisory nodes (fall predictor, self-collision) publish warnings only; safety_node is the only estop authority.
Not implemented: actual-speed / total-torque / tracking-error threshold checks.
